title: Taylor Expansion of a Geometric Bivariate Rational Function
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the quadratic Taylor polynomial for f(x, y) = 1 / (1 - x - y) about (0, 0).

steps.title: Apply Geometric Series Formula
steps.mathExpression: \frac{1}{1 - u} = 1 + u + u^2 + \cdots \quad \text{with } u = x + y
steps.explanation: Set u = x + y for |x + y| < 1.

steps.title: Expand and Collect Terms Through Degree 2
steps.explanation: Expand the square (x + y)^2 = x^2 + 2xy + y^2.
